'''Saylind Donels''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[youngling]] of the [[Jedi Order]]'s<ref name="SWVE" /> [[Bear Clan]].<ref name="Databank" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Donels and other members of the clan were being trained in [[lightsaber]] use by [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] when [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] came to Yoda seeking advice on his inability to find the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] in the [[Jedi Archives]]. After Kenobi brought up a [[star]] map, Yoda had the younglings make suggestions and Donels' classmate [[J. K. Burtola]] correctly suggested someone had erased the planet from the archives.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Saylind Donels first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> He was not identified in the film,<ref name="AOTC" /> but was named by [[Jason Fry]] in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]'',<ref name="AOTCVDE">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref> which was released in [[2013]] exclusively in Denmark.<ref name="AOTCVDEDate">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-attack-of-the-clones-the-expanded-visual-dictionary-the-book-i-didnt-know-existed|text=''Star Wars Attack of the Clones: The Expanded Visual Dictionary'' — The Book I Didn't Know Existed}}</ref> The name was confirmed to be [[canon]] by the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="SWVE" /> released on [[April 4]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-galaxy-guides-get-a-first-look-at-dks-star-wars-visual-encyclopedia-and-the-amazing-book-of-lego-star-wars|text=New Galaxy Guides: Get a First Look at DK's ''Star Wars Visual Encyclopedia'' and ''The Amazing Book of LEGO Star Wars''}}</ref>
